name: Alcubilla de las Peñas (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, crimson at the lower hoist and white at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcubilla de las Peñas (a tower on rocks on yellow above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Alcubilla de las Peñas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
